products.body_html:
Preciosa Ornela's 11/0 True Cut seed beads in Sfinx Orange come in a 6-hank quantity, giving you serious working stock of a cut bead that catches light differently than a standard round rocaille. The True Cut facet on each tiny 2.0–2.2 mm bead adds a subtle sparkle and textural edge that flat-finish rounds simply can't match.

  • Color: Sfinx Orange (opaque)
  • Finish: Sfinx
  • Material: Glass, made in Bohemia, Czechia
  • Quantity: 6 Hanks

Use these in loom or off-loom beadweaving — peyote, brick stitch, or herringbone — where the cut facets create a low-key shimmer across the fabric of the work. They're also a go-to for fringe, embroidery on garments, and festival or statement jewelry where a bold opaque orange with extra light play does the heavy lifting.

products.title: 12SK122-MR: Japanese Opaque Medium  Yellow Matte 12/0 50GM
products.body_html:
These 12/0 Japanese glass seed beads in Opaque Medium Yellow Matte come in a generous 50g quantity, giving you plenty to work with on any scale of project. The 1.8–2.0 mm size hits a sweet spot between the fine detail of an 11/0 and the chunkier presence of a 6/0, making them a versatile workhorse in your rotation.

The matte opaque finish gives this medium yellow a soft, chalky warmth — no shine, no shimmer, just a grounded, flat color that reads as confident and clean rather than flashy.

Specifications

  • Size: 12/0
  • Color: Yellows (opaque)
  • Finish: Opaque/Matte
  • Material: Glass
  • Quantity: 50g

What to make with them

Their consistent sizing makes them well-suited for loom weaving and peyote stitch where tight bead-to-bead registration matters, and that muted yellow tone plays especially well in geometric or retro-inspired patterns where you want a sunny accent that doesn't compete with neighboring colors.

products.title: 5SK112-MR: Japanese Medium Opaque White Matte 5/0 50 Gram Bag
products.body_html:
These Japanese 5/0 seed beads in opaque matte white come in a generous 50g bag, giving you a substantial working supply of a genuinely versatile neutral. At 4.3–4.8 mm, they're large enough to make a real visual statement while still threading up quickly for bigger-scale work.

The matte finish softens the white to a chalky, light-absorbing tone — no shine, no glare, just a clean, quiet surface that reads as warm and tactile rather than stark.

Specifications

  • Size: 05/0
  • Color: Whites (opaque)
  • Finish: Opaque/Matte
  • Material: Glass
  • Quantity: 50g

What to make with them

Their size makes them well-suited for chunky loom-woven bands, macramé accent rows, and kumihimo braids where you want a bold, readable pattern. 14SD7785: DB2380 Delica Fancy Lined Teal 11/0 - 50GM
products.body_html:
Miyuki DB2380 Delica 11/0 beads in Fancy Inside Lined Teal come in a generous 50g quantity — enough to commit fully to a large loom piece, a statement necklace, or a serious peyote project without rationing every gram.

A decorative inner lining shows through the transparent glass, giving the teal a layered, luminous depth that shifts between rich and watery depending on the light.

Specifications

  • Size: 11/0
  • Color: Greens
  • Finish: Fancy Inside Lined
  • Origin: Japan
  • Quantity: 50g

What to make with them

The precision tube-cut cylinder shape makes these an ideal choice for loom weaving and off-loom stitches like peyote or brick stitch, where the flat-to-flat fit produces that tight, fabric-like surface — and the teal colorway works especially well in coastal or nature-inspired patterns where you want color with some complexity.

products.title: 11SB109: CZ Seed Bead Op Black 11/0 6HK
products.body_html:
Six hanks of Preciosa Ornela 11/0 opaque black seed beads, cut from glass tube in Bohemia, give you serious working quantity of one of the most versatile colors in any maker's repertoire.

The opaque finish delivers a solid, non-translucent black — no light passes through, so the color reads as flat, graphic, and high-contrast against virtually any palette.

Specifications

  • Size: 11/0
  • Color: Op Black (opaque)
  • Finish: Opaque
  • Material: Glass, made in Bohemia, Czechia
  • Quantity: 6 Hanks

What to make with them

Use them as a bold outline color in loom or peyote work, as a grounding neutral in bead embroidery, or string them alone for sleek, minimalist rope necklaces and gothic-inspired fringe pieces.
